mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by over 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in annual inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy in response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual rise > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change <= 0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL annual rise > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change <= 0%).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% in one month signals weakening housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls by over 0.5% in 1 month during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% in the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month signals a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month AND RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and RSAFS fall by over 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing to prevent recession, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in the prior month.
